Class AsyncRunner

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.network.AsyncRunner
public class AsyncRunner extends Object
The AsyncRunner class provides a utility for executing tasks asynchronously using a single-threaded ExecutorService. This ensures that tasks are processed sequentially, preventing potential concurrency issues when updating shared resources or dispatching events that require a specific order.

  • Method Details

    • run

      public CompletableFuture<Void> run(AsyncRunner.SafeRunnable task)
      Submits a AsyncRunner.SafeRunnable task for asynchronous execution. The task will be executed by the internal single-threaded executor.
      Parameters:
      task - The AsyncRunner.SafeRunnable task to be executed. This is a functional interface that allows for throwing checked exceptions.
      Returns:
      A CompletableFuture<Void> representing the completion of the task.

    • shutdown

      public void shutdown()
      Initiates an orderly shutdown of the executor service. Previously submitted tasks are executed, but no new tasks will be accepted.
